pages_inspected.title: Clothing stores: how do you check supplier files before importing to Shopify?
pages_inspected.opening_post_quote: I’m looking into a small tool for clothing stores ... compare the original supplier file with the CSV you’re preparing for Shopify ... I’m considering around $19 as a one-time price. Nothing built or for sale yet.
pages_inspected.reply_quote: Usually the supplier file is checked against the Shopify-ready CSV in Excel, mainly looking at SKUs, variant values and prices. The most time-consuming part is usually finding small differences when there are a lot of rows.
pages_inspected.rejection_reason: Market-research survey by a prospective tool builder, not a merchant request with explicit input/output. Requested job (diff supplier file vs prepared Shopify CSV) differs from our transformer (supplier rows -> Shopify variant CSV); our verify.py checks identifier preservation but not price/field diffs. Answering would be self-promotion in someone else's research thread.

other_listed_topics_not_opened: Remaining recent results (<=90 days) were already-answered how-to threads (variant availability by location, NS/PID identifiers, BFCM pricing) or vendor self-promotion posts; none matched our transform input/output. Older threads (created before 2026-08-09) are outside the 90-day rule.
competitive_observations_untrusted: Topic 708266 (2026-11-02): a vendor advertises Shopify CSV import repair at fixed USD 25 with a free assessment first (advertised, not verified sales).
Topic 707458 (2026-10-31) and 665019 (2026-08-11): free Shopify CSV checkers promoted by others.
Topic 683136: prospective USD 19 one-time diff tool; one agency reply describes manual Excel checking of supplier vs Shopify CSV.
interpretation: The free-checker space on Shopify Community is crowded and the price anchors observed are USD 19-25. That is evidence of a low price ceiling, not of demand for our sample. No worked answer was prepared, nothing was posted, and no contact was made. Submission route would be a Shopify Community account (not held).
